options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:

Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Victory Locations
options.doc: How many checks are sent per level completed.

options.name: Objective Locations
options.doc: How many checks are sent per side objective completed.

options.name: Level Shuffle Seed
options.doc: What seed to use for level shuffling. 0 uses the world seed.

options.name: Commander Choice
options.doc:
How the player's commander is selected for missions.

- Locked Random: The player's commander is randomly predetermined for each level.

- Unlockable Factions: The player starts with Mercival and can unlock playable factions.

- Random Starting Faction:  The player starts with a random starting faction and can unlock the rest.

When playing with unlockable factions, faction items are added to the pool.

options.name: Enabled Commanders
options.doc:
The commanders available to the player and the AI.
If no commanders are enabled, Mercival will be the only available commander.

Format as a comma-separated list of commander names: ["Mercia", "Valder"]

options.name: FinalLevels
options.doc: How many final levels to beat before victory is achieved.

options.name: death_link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Income Boost

options.doc_fr: Combien de revenus supplémentaires le joueur obtient par tour par boost reçu.

options.name: Commander Defense Boost
options.doc: How much extra defense the player's commander gets per boost received.
options.doc_fr: Combien de défense supplémentaire le commandant du joueur reçoit par boost reçu.

options.name: Groove Boost

options.name: Player Sacrifice Limit
options.doc:
How many times the player can sacrifice a unit at the Stronghold per level attempt.
Sacrificed units are stored in the multiworld for other players to summon.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de fois le joueur peut sacrifier une unité à la forteresse par tentative de niveau.
Les unités sacrifiées sont stockées dans le multimonde pour que d'autres joueurs les invoquent.

options.name: Player Summon Limit
options.doc:
How many times the player can summon a unit at the Stronghold per level attempt.
Summoned units are from the multiworld which were sacrificed by other players.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de fois le joueur peut convoquer une unité au Stronghold par tentative de niveau.
Les unités citées viennent du multimonde qui a été sacrifié par d'autres joueurs.

options.name: AI Sacrifice Limit
options.doc:
How many times the AI can sacrifice a unit at the Stronghold per level attempt.
Sacrificed units are stored in the multiworld for other AIs to summon.
options.doc_fr:
Combien de fois l'IA peut sacrifier une unité à la forteresse par tentative de niveau.
Les unités sacrifiées sont stockées dans le multimonde pour que d'autres IA appellent.

options.name: AI Summon Limit
options.doc:
How many times the AI can summon a unit at the Stronghold per level attempt.
Summoned units are from the multiworld which were sacrificed by other AIs.
If a level becomes impossible, use /sacrifice_summon in the client to toggle sacrifices and summons on and off.

options.name: Player Barracks Early Sphere Cost
options.doc:
The cost multiplier of units purchased from the player's barracks in earlier spheres.
The map's victory item determines the sphere number.
If a level becomes impossible, use /toggle_costs in the client to toggle dynamic unit costs on and off.

options.name: Custom early level playlist
options.doc:
A list of levels available after the first level.
Removing levels from this list prevents them from showing up in the game.
If the number of levels removed is less than the available levels, then filler levels will be in their place.
Filler levels do not contain items and automatically provide a victory.

Format as a comma-separated list of early level names: ["Swimming at the Docks", "Floran Trap"]
options.doc_fr:
Une liste des niveaux disponibles après le premier niveau.
Enlever les niveaux de cette liste les empêche d'apparaître dans le jeu.
Si le nombre de niveaux supprimés est inférieur aux niveaux disponibles, alors les niveaux de remplissage seront à leur place.
Les niveaux de remplissage ne contiennent pas d'éléments et fournissent automatiquement une victoire.

Format comme une liste séparée par des virgules des noms de niveau précoce : ["Nage aux quais", "Piège Floran"]

options.name: Custom main level playlist
options.doc:

Removing levels from this list prevents them from showing up in the game.
If the number of levels removed is less than the available levels, then filler levels will be in their place.
Filler levels do not contain items and automatically provide a victory.

Format as a comma-separated list of main level names: ["Wagon Freeway", "Operation Seagull"]
options.doc_fr:
Une liste des niveaux disponibles après les premiers niveaux.
Enlever les niveaux de cette liste les empêche d'apparaître dans le jeu.

Les niveaux de remplissage ne contiennent pas d'éléments et fournissent automatiquement une victoire.

Format comme une liste séparée par des virgules des noms principaux de niveau : ["Wagon Freeway", "Operation Seagull"]

options.name: Custom final level playlist

options.doc_fr:
